model_meta.description: Conceptual model of a one-way clutch with a casing, axially movable ratchet, engagement teeth, and biasing mechanism.

subsystems.description: First casing plate with hub and radial flange; typically connected to the drive member and rotationally coupled to the ratchet while allowing axial sliding.
Second casing plate with radial wall and peripheral wall, defining the interior with the inner plate; typically connected to the driven member.
Plate positioned inside the casing, rotationally coupled to the inner plate and axially displaceable; carries complementary engagement teeth.
Mechanism providing axial force to engage the ratchet and outer-plate surfaces; implementations include spring, hydraulic actuation, or torque-responsive angled mating features.
External rotating member connected to the clutch inner plate; represented as an external source of rotational torque.
External member connected to the clutch outer plate and receiving transmitted torque.

steps.description: The inner plate rotationally couples to the ratchet while permitting axial sliding.
Biasing force urges the ratchet teeth toward complementary teeth on the outer plate.
Engaging axial tooth faces transmit torque to the outer plate; inclined faces permit relative slippage and axial displacement in the opposite rotation.

In the hydraulic implementation, entry ports admit fluid into the interior; the ports selectively supply fluid to either side of the ratchet plate, corresponding to the upper and lower cavities adjacent to the plate.
Fluid pressure on a selected side of the ratchet plate provides axial bias; supplying the respective side is described as producing engagement or disengagement of the complementary tooth surfaces.

An exit port in the second plate is described as relieving pressure by removing fluid from the cavity between opposing ratchet and second-plate surfaces; apertures between teeth separately permit fluid venting. The description identifies port 64b as removing fluid from cavity 70, without asserting that the claim's exit port is necessarily that same port.

actions.name: Convert applied torque to ratchet axial thrust

steps.description: Complementary angularly oriented splines between the first plate and ratchet plate respond to torque applied to the clutch by producing axial thrust of the ratchet plate.
